steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: This... should be the place, right?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Mm. No doubt about it.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Neat. Just gotta check, Silence, she really wanted to meet you here?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: This looks like a real-ass bar. In pretty lively shape, too...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: But nobody's home.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: True. The liquor is all laid out very tidily, with an orderly ambience to match.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Pretty bizarre. Should we head back, maybe? Not long till we gotta get going.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No. Whoever invited us knows about Anthony's jailbreak, and that he's with us, on top of...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Of?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We'll be heading off tonight.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Let me check over the miscellanies one more time.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hm? A message?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't remember anyone in this city having my contact info...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Wait, is this... an internal band?!
Ms. Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Who are you?
No one important. What's important is that I know you have Anthony, and you're the one who broke him out.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...I don't know what you're talking about.
No need to panic. Even if I can't prove it, you can rest assured that I'm no bad actor. Otherwise, I wouldn't go to the trouble of establishing contact with you on an inside wire.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: State your intentions.
All I want is to invite you and Mayer the Engineer out, for a chat.
I'll take that as a yes. Now, the address is...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: On top of the fact that she sounded absolutely vile.
Hearing that as soon as I come in hurts me a little, you know.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Whozzit?
Hiya~
I reserved the entire bar. It's just us three all alone here.
I really wanted to chit-chat with you in a normal bar, but in the end, this isn't something we can let just anyone hear.
So, sorries~

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You're...
Alright, let's all introduce ourselves.
I'm the Director of Ecological, Muelsyse.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I remember you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Wowie, you know me? I'm blessed.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: My mentor once mentioned you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright, your turn now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Do you need to ask?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aww, there's a ritual to these things.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Structural, Silence.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Engineering, Lutra Workshop, Mayer.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I hear you're all with an organization called Rhodes Island now.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: How'd you get mixed up in this, then?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...None of your business.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Don't tell me you were behind all this...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Keheh. I dunno, what do you think?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, likely not.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ooh? You sure about that?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If you could find us yourself, there's no reason you wouldn't know that Anthony has long since left Columbia.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If you were the hand behind the curtain, a priori, there's absolutely no reason to seek us out.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hmhmm. True, true.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If I'm the hidey-hand, I should be running around headless right now looking for Anthony, huh?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But something tells me they won't lie down and take it, ya know? Your bodyguards have any idea how tough they are?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Don't worry yourself.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You sure, eh? Worry I won't, then.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Uh, Silence, time out. If she's not behind all this, then she's...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's not clear to me yet either.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But you're linked to this case, and you want something out of us here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: This is why you were Director Parvis's star pupil over in Structural. You're a real smarty. I love chatting it up with people like you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Don't change the subject, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Anthony left Columbia. His assassination has failed. Mayer and I are ordinary people who just so happened to have come to Columbia.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What is it you could want from us, all told?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aww, relax a little.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm ordinary too! Just a researcher here. I pose no imminent threat to you~

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The booze in this bar's four-star, at least. Wanna sit down and chat over some drinks?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hey. You think we can, Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Oh, fine. I've got things I want to know, too.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Sweet. Lemme take a look, then... I waaant this one!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ooh, you've got a sharp eye. I like the Riesling a lot. Not too high proof, but the aroma can strongarm you.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Huh? I'm not actually that good with alcohol...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Then let me recommend a fruit wine. Very low alcohol content, very friendly flavor.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Really? I'll give it a shot, then.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Goodie. What about you, Ms. Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Plain hot water will be fine.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aww, you come to a place like this and don't even wanna try anything more fun?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not interested.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Fiiine, fine.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright, ladies, have a seat.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Whoa. This is actually really tasty.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Glad you like it.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Can we get to the topic at hand?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We can.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Down to business, then. The way I see it, we both have questions, so we may as well trade answers.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course, some questions will be off limits, but let's agree not to play any boring little word games, shall we?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And in the interest of demonstrating my goodwill, I'll give you one free question before we start. Ask away~

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: How did you find us?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's a pretty... trivial first question. You sure? I thought you'd ask something more straight to the point.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Please answer the question, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Whether or not you believe me, me and HydeBro's strike teams have nothing to do with each other.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: HydeBro... They're the company who moved against Anthony in this, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Righty. You've got history with them. Probably don't need too much introduction.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: HydeBro. Former building materials juggernaut in Bunkerhill City. Once clashed head-to-head with the up-and-coming Simon Co.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eep. They were up-and-coming back then?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes. Simon Co. originally was in the logistics business. By all accounts, the call was made to move into building supplies at a board meeting.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The company was named after the family, and half of its top-floor employees were related to the CEO, Smith Simon.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Including the person at the heart of this affair—Anthony Simon, his one and only son.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The short story is, whether it was over or under the table, the two companies fought it out, and they fought hard. To the point of blood, some rumors even say.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And in the end, one can say Simon Co. lost. Ever since, HydeBro has enjoyed a very real monopoly on construction supply commerce in not just Bunkerhill, but surrounding cities as well.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hmhmm. All correct. Gold star for you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ultimately, you all come together in Ironforge City and shook them off. P.S., I've gotta say you did a beautiful job.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...But we didn't shake you off.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ahah. Too true.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I see you're not denying you were in league with them.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hmm... I feel like you've got your guess, honestly speaking.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But I can tell you, I borrowed their communication channels for sure.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Not like there's room to breathe. If I didn't do this, I'd probably end up the biggest loser out of this whole thing.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So, I think we can get into grilling each other now. One asks, the other answers. You start.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No. Let's have you start, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Whoo. Can I?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I want to know what your game is here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alrighty. What I wanna know is...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ms. Silence, how did your helper get in touch with Anthony, and aid him in a successful jailbreak, while in prison? I want a grasp on how that went down.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's all in the past. Why do you want to know about it?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Because I don't get how this jailbreak happened at all.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The only parts I understand are the beginning—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: —HydeBro initiated this assassination plot they'd been brewing forever against Anthony Simon—the last of the Simons—who was locked up in Mansfield State Prison.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And then the very end—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: —where Anthony led a group that successfully escaped Mansfield, and then met up with you two, and made it out of Columbia.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: As for everything in between... well, I had a chance to find out, but that's slipped away by now. Very sad about that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So I want to hear it from you. Just what happened?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is not fair at all.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Relax, I'm not here to try and get the whole thing in one single question.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You can toss out your own questions when you see fit, and I'll do my bestest to answer.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course, I might have other questions too, but prooobably not that many~

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Okay, being serious, we're only doing this I-ask-you-ask because we still don't know each other that well.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Who can say if once we become friends, we'll let all the beans spill~

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...I do not intend to become your friend, and this is going to take an awful amount of time.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aren't you 'just ordinary people in Columbia' right now? You're not in any sort of rush, are you?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course, you're free to turn tail and leave, but. First thing: I have no way to guarantee you'll actually make it out.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Second thing: I have no idea how much you really know, but this is probs your one and only chance to pry intel out of me, Ecological Director Muelsyse. You really wanna let that go?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...You're threatening me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm giving you the option that's least likely to get you hurt, Researcher Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Fine. I see you want to know, no matter what, and we're in no rush at all.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hey, I know this story. Can I just be drawing up some plans on the side here?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Go for it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Kafka... was that your assistant's name?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Don't think I ever saw her name in any list of staff to do with you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She isn't a Rhine Lab employee.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Rhine Lab would never hire her, and her interest in scientific research is roughly zero.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Huh. So how do you know each other?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Coincidentally.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But that's another story. All you need to know is she's a friend of mine.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She's the one who helped me gather all my intel on the Simon family.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ooh? She sounds like a real doer to me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And very loyal. Not many people would become a criminal and get thrown in prison for the sake of a friend, would they?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I remunerated her appropriately.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And she had her own goal in being imprisoned—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Her own goal?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: According to her, she always wanted to experience true prison life, just once.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: From her angle, my request must've seemed like I was paying her for it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...What an oddball she is.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Undoubtedly. I can't comprehend her sort of mentality, to say the least.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She sought out a carpenter named Mina to pose as staff when entering the prison, and she got sent in herself as a convict.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Is Mina that one Liberi in your team?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She is.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: From the sound of it, she was a total third party. Why'd you yank her into this?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not too sure, either. All Kafka said was that Mina once had Anthony's aid, and so would be willing to go inside to help him.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The long and short of it is she accepted my request, and entered Mansfield State Prison...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Royal flush!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Ah-hah. Stayin' on top.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Tsk, damnit. Lost again. Hey, Kafka, you're not cheating, are you?

steps.name: Infected Prisoner B
steps.text: Ain't anyone else's fault you're bad. See? Both Kafka's hands, empty. How's she gonna cheat?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yeah, 'zactly.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Mumbled) Not my business you hold your cards so crappy I can see 'em.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: But who'da thunk it.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: First I saw you as some weedy little brat. My shame. You're better than I thought.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: And you got word from my momma! You're a real friend, fair 'n' square.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hey, hey, hey, how many times I gotta tell ya? I'm already all grown up!

steps.name: Infected Prisoner B
steps.text: Hahah, truth! Oughta be callin' you a 'lady!'

steps.name: Infected Prisoner C
steps.text: Whoo-wee, Kafka, ma'am!

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Hey, you lot, break time's over.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Back to work!

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Anyone slacking, you can kiss goodbye to your dinner!

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, whatever.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Pff. You're just some jailer. Who made you king?

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: What did you say? Speak up.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: I said, I need a toilet!

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Hold it in!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: These jailers have a real bad attitude...

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Hey, Kafka, seeing as you can get a thing or two, I'll give you some advice.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Dunno where you muddled on outside, but in Mansfield, I say you'd better keep your tail between your legs, figuratively speaking.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Whyzat?

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: You know well as me, this is a nomadic prison we're in.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Times are it visits cities for supplies, maybe takes on a few new inmates. Otherwise, it roams around the wilderness and nobody gives a hoot.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: So in here, two and two can make fish. Only law is the jailers' law.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I guess so.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Hey, sort of a bright side, though.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Outside, it's just us Infected what don't get treated human.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: But once you're in here, you ain't treated human whoever you are. Bastards in A-Zone don't live any better than we do.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: I think of that, and I feel swell.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: A-Zone?

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: Ah, right, you're fresh. People what ain't Infected get cells in A-Zone, and us Infected get in B-Zone.

steps.name: Infected Prisoner A
steps.text: That's how we know 'em by, anyway. A-Zone, B-Zone.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Ohh—

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Heh. Can't help but say, Kafka, you came in just the right time.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uh-huh?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Today's the big event. You're in luck, making it.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: What's the event?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: You'll know damn soon.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Speaking of, what's that room over there for?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Looks like a factory line to me. Why's it split off from our side? No one in there either.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Where d'you mean?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Oh, that's C-Zone's special assembly line.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: C-Zone?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: They're the ones living in that tower dead center of the place. That's what we call C-Zone.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Scarce few there, but they've all made major messes. They'll pretty much be serving all their lives.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: They gotta work too, but it ain't gonna be with us.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: So that's where they do it.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Ohh... anyone in there called Anthony?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Anthony? Whassup, you know him?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Eh, I wouldn't say we know each other. Just heard he was in here too.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Where else is he gonna be...?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner B
steps.text: Hey. Zip it. You about ready?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: It's starting? Damn, took long enough!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Whassappening whassappenning?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uh, why do you all look like you're getting together...

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Kafka, you're new here. Don't try anything today, save you getting hurt.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Just grab some kinda something and hide.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Here's a front-row ticket to Mansfield's big regular fixture—gang fighting!
